federal_note: Federal programs (DTC, Child Disability Benefit, RDSP, Canada Child Benefit, Canada Disability Benefit for adults, Jordan's Principle, Inuit Child First) apply everywhere; see data/programs.json.

programs.name: Children's disABILITY Services (CDS)
programs.what: Help for families raising a child with a disability or autism. This can include respite (a break for you), autism services, and help with your child's growth. Being accepted does not promise a certain service.
programs.amount: Services based on assessed need; no fixed amount published.
who: Your child is under 18 and lives in Manitoba with you.
Your child has autism, a developmental delay, an intellectual disability, or a lifelong problem walking or moving.
steps: Fill in the Referral and Intake form.
Send it with your child's diagnosis letter to your local CDS office.
programs.nickname: CDS (Manitoba help for kids with disabilities)

programs.name: Manitoba Supports for Persons with Disabilities (MSPD)
programs.what: Monthly money for adults with a serious, long-term disability. It also helps with rent.
programs.amount: Search summary reported $647.17/month basic needs plus up to $816 Rent Assist for a single adult (July 2026), from a non-government source; NOT verified on gov.mb.ca.
who: Adults with a serious, long-term disability.
steps: See the official page to apply.

programs.name: Rent Assist
programs.what: Monthly help to pay rent if your income is low. Working families can get it too.
programs.amount: No fixed amount published; check the official page.
who: You rent your home and have low income.
steps: Apply through Manitoba Families. See the official page.

programs.name: Jordan's Principle (First Nations children)
programs.what: Money from the federal government for First Nations kids. It can pay for therapy, respite (a break for you while someone else cares for your child), talking devices, and equipment. It works in every province, on or off reserve.
programs.amount: Case by case; no fixed amount.
who: Your child is First Nations and under 19
steps: Call 1-855-572-4453. The line is open 24 hours a day.
Or apply online on the Indigenous Services Canada website.
programs.nickname: Jordan's Principle (help for First Nations kids)
